# MetaBlooms Semester Case Study (School System)

## Context
Grade 3 Math, 18-week semester.

## Base Artifacts
- Lesson Plan v0
- Standards: TEKS 3.3A–G

## Deltas Over Time
Weeks 1–4:
- Added number line models
- Constraint locked: "Concrete before abstract"

Weeks 5–9:
- Assessment drift detected
- Override issued for pacing

Weeks 10–14:
- Constraint split: remediation vs enrichment

Weeks 15–18:
- Stable lesson set locked

## Outcomes
- Reduced reteach time
- Clear audit trail of instructional decisions
- Safe rollback when experiments failed
